notes: Registry ownership is mandatory. Selected the explicit 30-day In-hospital Mortality measure in the first-listed registry, NCT02444988 (SMART-MED): these are medical-ICU cohort counts, not the combined population of PMID 29485925. The outcome name Mortality does not distinguish the two registry cohorts. NCT02547779 (SMART-SURG) also reports 30-day In-hospital Mortality: Balanced Crystalloids OG001 400/5207 and 0.9% Sodium Chloride OG000 408/5214. Both registries also report the same respective deaths and denominators in adverseEventsModule (EG001 and EG000). doc_ctgov_results_NCT02444988.json repeats the selected medical-ICU outcome. The publication doc_ft_29485925.txt Table 2 reports combined-cohort in-hospital death before 30 days: balanced crystalloids 818/7942 and saline 875/7860; other mortality candidates are death before ICU discharge 528/7942 and 572/7860, and before 60 days 928/7942 and 975/7860. The abstract reports only mortality percentages. No cohort counts were summed; the combined publication counts were not substituted for registry group counts.
